 Breakfast sandwiches recalled in Oregon and Washington 
 By FOX 12 Staff Published : Nov. 11, 2026 at 10:57 AM PST | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Fresh & Ready Foods is recalling 2,414 breakfast sandwiches distributed in Oregon and Washington because they may be contaminated with listeria, according to an announcement published by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
 The recall covers Fresh to You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches in 4.6-ounce packages with “Fresh Thru” dates of Nov. 7 through Nov. 19. The date is printed on the front label. The sandwiches have SKU 3100048 and UPC 8 405493 0168 4.
 Fresh & Ready Foods is recalling sausage, egg and cheese biscuit sandwiches sold in Oregon and Washington over possible listeria contamination. (FDA) Fresh & Ready Foods is recalling sausage, egg and cheese biscuit sandwiches sold in Oregon and Washington over possible listeria contamination. (FDA) The sandwiches were made at a Fresh & Ready facility in Renton, Washington, and distributed to employee break rooms, refrigerated vending machines and cafeterias between Oct. 25 and Nov. 4, according to the announcement.
 The recall is connected to a recall by CH Guenther & Son involving biscuits that may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. Fresh & Ready Foods said it used the affected biscuits in the recalled sandwiches.
 No illnesses had been reported as of the announcement. No other Fresh to You or Fresh & Ready Foods products, production dates or products made at other Fresh & Ready facilities are affected, the company said.
 Listeria can cause serious and sometimes deadly infections, particularly in young children, older adults and people with weakened immune systems. Infection during pregnancy can cause miscarriage or stillbirth. Healthy people may experience short-term symptoms including fever, headache, stiffness, nausea, abdominal pain and diarrhea.
 Consumers should not eat the recalled sandwiches and should throw away any remaining product. For questions or a full refund, contact Fresh & Ready Foods at RecallConcern@HotLineGlobal.com or 855-424-8390, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern time.
